title: Bayesian Inference
description: Belief is a probability, and evidence should change it by a fixed rule: how likely the evidence was if you are right, against how likely it was anyway. Unlocks the Bayesian Analyzer and the Prior and Posterior Tablets.

puzzle.goal: A condition affects a fraction p of people. A check comes back positive with probability L when it is present, and wrongly with probability F when it is not. Write the chance Q that someone who checks positive really has it.
puzzle.name: Bayes' rule
puzzle.ask: Find Q for a condition in 1% of people, a check that finds it 99% of the time and gives false alarms 5% of the time.

vars.L: chance of a positive when present

puzzle.method: Of all the positives, the true ones are L·p and the false ones F·(1 − p). Q is the true share.
